remediation_item: P7/P9 governance+compliance routers + P1 engine-job router mount declared
description: A-3 / B-6 service-subpackage boundary policy. Every cross-subpackage import inside the services tier (services.<a> importing services.<b>, a != b) must be declared here with a rationale. Enforced by tools/check_service_boundaries.py, which measures the edges with tools/dependency_graph.py (AST scan of production files; test modules excluded). The list is deliberately ADDITIVE and HONEST: it records the 139 edges that exist today (measured 2026-10-11 over 923 production files, 1696 module-level edges), so the current coupling is stated rather than hidden, and every edge is dated for review instead of silently frozen. The count was 137 on 2026-10-11 and rose to 139 for A-2 step 1 (the facade re-exports its six per-domain adapters) plus D4 (the facade raises services.api_gateway.errors_gateway.GatewayCallError): both are the declared, dated bridges of a recorded remediation item, not new coupling. Removing an entry turns that import into a violation; adding one requires a rationale and the same expiry mechanism as tools/import_guard_policy.json (B-1). The count is 146 as of 2026-10-11 (P1 engine-job router mount).

scope.edge_shape: from and to are graph areas: the top-level package for non-services areas, services.<subpackage> inside the services tier (services._gateway_facade is the sanctioned bridge file, not a subpackage directory)
scope.not_covered_here: engine -> services / services -> engine (governed by tools/import_guard_policy.json and tools/detect_imports.py), services -> database (persistence access, governed by the database tier), and intra-subpackage imports (allowed by definition)

ratchet.note: A-3 done-criterion is an allowlist of <= 20 edges. That is only reachable by the A-2 gateway/service split (gateway routers become the single composition root and the shared error/auth contracts move to services._contracts), not by editing this file: today's 137 edges are the measured truth. The ratchet fails the check when the measured count exceeds max, so the number can only go down on purpose. max was 137 until 2026-10-11, when A-2 step 1 + D4 added the two declared facade edges above (the six adapter re-exports measure as one area edge, the typed GatewayCallError as the other); the ceiling rose with them deliberately, and those two entries are the first candidates to fold away once the routers stop importing the facade directly. The ceiling rose from 140 to 144 on 2026-10-11 with the P7/P9 governance and compliance routers (two new edges each way), declared rather than added silently. The ceiling rose from 144 to 145 on 2026-10-11 with the P13 engine-job bridge (declared). The ceiling rose from 145 to 146 on 2026-10-11 with the P13/P1 engine-job router mount in services/api_gateway/main.py (one new edge, declared). The ceiling rose from 146 to 150 on 2026-10-14 during the frontend/backend integration pass: the extracted auth lockout surface (services.auth, declared both from services.api_gateway and services.auth_legacy) plus the knowledge and tasmimyar routers' gateway auth dependencies, all four declared rather than added silently.
